resources.string: Drawing together is being checked. Keep drawing on this device for now.
Exchange drawing-device files directly with your other device, then ask halo to start with a saved sketch. Pairing alone does not start sharing.
The device file could not be used. Choose a fresh file shared directly by your device.
%1$s will be allowed to send drawing input only after you start a sharing session. Choose Trust only if this file came directly from your device.
Could not save locally. Keep this drawing open and free some storage.
The other sketch changed. Your drawing stays on this device; review both before syncing.
Disconnected. You can keep drawing here; completed edits stay on this device.
A local drawing was recovered. Review it before sending it to the other device.
